notes: ὡς is taken as the complementizer of the accusation clause rather than a comparative; the ASV writes only 'that' (rule 40).
οὗτος → 'the same' takes the whole determiner expression and no article competes, headed on 'same' (rules 38, 49).
The supplied 'a' rides with τις as part of 'a certain', matching 16:19 and 16:20 in this chapter (rule 24); giving it to ἄνθρωπος under rule 58 remains defensible.
